resources.string: Choose the app language. E go apply to Sekuvo only, e no go affect the rest of the phone.
Choose the layouts wey you dey really use. Na only the ones you tick go show when you dey type secret for computer — the rest no go disturb you.
At least one layout go always dey on.

E be vault wey dey fully offline for password, card, and note. E no dey ask for internet permission, so technically e no fit send your data go anywhere — no account, no cloud, no sync, no analytics. Everything dey encrypt with AES-256-GCM under key wey dem derive from your master password.
Sekuvo no dey collect, transmit, or share any data. E be offline password vault wey no dey ask for Internet permission, so technically e no fit send your data go anywhere.

Titles, usernames, passwords, notes, and usage history dey stay for dis device, encrypted with key wey dem derive from your master password. Nothing no dey upload, sync, or backup go any server by the app.
Permissions and why dem dey there

Camera — na only for scan QR codes wey you choose to scan, and e dey process for the device.\nBiometric — na only to unlock the vault for your device, through Android biometric system. Sekuvo no dey ever see or store your fingerprint or face.\nBluetooth — na only when you ask Sekuvo directly to type secret for computer wey near you. Na only the character wey you choose go send, direct to the device wey pair with am.

Dis dem happen only when you start am, e go produce encrypted file or QR codes wey password wey you set dey protect, and e go save or show only where you direct am. The app no dey ever send am anywhere by itself.
Sekuvo no dey collect data from anybody, including children.
Questions: contact@sekuvo.com\nThe official version of dis policy dey published for sekuvo.com/privacy/ and e go be the correct one if difference dey.
First time you dey run am

You go set master password. Every secret wey you save go encrypt with key wey dem derive from am, so na the only thing wey Sekuvo no fit help you recover — write am for safe place before you continue.\nYou dey come from another phone? Tap "I get backup — restore am" for the welcome screen: you still go set master password for dis device first, then the file picker go open by itself.

Account/Password, Everyday (name, phone, email, address), Card, and Secure note — with subtypes for scripts, keys, recovery codes, and config files. Account and Everyday entries fit also take unlimited custom fields, wey dem encrypt exactly like the built-in ones.

Settings → Turn on autofill → choose Sekuvo from the system list. Dis list name different for each device — for Samsung and Android 14+ na "Passwords, passkeys & autofill → Preferred service", for pure Android na "Autofill service".\nAfter dis, touching login field or card field for any app go offer your entries. While the vault dey lock, the system no go receive anything at all.

Settings → Turn on the keyboard, then choose "Sekuvo Keyboard" from the keyboard switcher when you need am. E dey type saved values direct inside any field, with search and recent entries on top. While e dey lock, e dey show only the entries wey you mark for quick access.

Open the entry, tap the 💻 icon near the field, and KEEP DIS SCREEN OPEN — the phone go only announce itself as keyboard while dis screen dey open. For the computer, add the phone as new Bluetooth device and confirm the code. Go back to the phone, choose your computer, choose the COMPUTER keyboard layout, click the field wey you want, and tap Type.\nE connect but nothing no dey type? Usually the reason na say the computer don pair your phone before as ordinary phone, so e never turn on keyboard service for am. Remove the pairing from BOTH sides, open the 💻 screen, and pair again starting from the computer. For Windows, after dis, Device Manager → Human Interface Devices suppose show "Bluetooth HID" device. For macOS, close the Keyboard Setup Assistant if e open.\nUse the speed test as diagnosis: nothing wey type mean pairing problem, character wey scatter mean layout problem, typing wey cut mean speed problem.

The vault go lock the moment the screen wey e open on off — closing foldable phone dey count too. Leaving the app while the screen still on no dey lock am: the app, the keyboard, and autofill dey share one session.

System backup dey off on purpose, so na only one way your vault fit comot from the phone: Settings → Create encrypted backup. Use backup password wey different from your master password. The .vaultbak file wey e produce, plus dis password, go restore everything for any phone, even after factory reset.

The ➕ button dey offer "Import through QR" and "Import from text". The ⇄ wizard dey do both for one flow: e go generate one-time transfer password, type am for computer through Bluetooth, then collect the envelope back either by scanning QR or from clipboard — e go decrypt am with the same password.\nThe computer-side tool na file wey you download, e no be website: get aktar.html from the project Releases page, check the SHA-256, and open am from your own disk. Dis site no go ever ask you for secret.
Check the address — e need @ and domain like example.com
Enter the month and year for MMYY format (month 01–12)

The check digits for dis IBAN no match, so e likely say one digit wrong. You fit still save am — but if na typing mistake, you go only notice am once the transfer fail.
